          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-apply">
	mesheryctl design apply
</h1>
<p>Apply design file</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Apply design will trigger deploy of the design file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design apply [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>apply a design file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design apply -f [file | URL]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>deploy a saved design</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design apply [design-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string   Path to design file
  -h, --help          help for apply
      --skip-save     Skip saving a design

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl design apply
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/patternApply.png" alt="pattern-apply-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-delete">
	mesheryctl design delete
</h1>
<p>Delete design file</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>delete design file will trigger deletion of the design file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design delete [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>delete a design file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design delete [file | URL]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string   Path to design file
  -h, --help          help for delete

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-deploy">
	mesheryctl design deploy
</h1>
<p>Deploy design</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Command will trigger deploy of design</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design deploy [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Deploy design by providing file path</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design deploy -f [filepath] -s [source type]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string          Path to design file
  -h, --help                 help for deploy
      --skip-save            Skip saving a design
  -s, --source-type string   Type of source file (ex. manifest / compose / helm)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl design deploy
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/pattern-onboard.png" alt="pattern-onboard-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-export">
	mesheryctl design export
</h1>
<p>Export a design from Meshery</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>The &rsquo;export&rsquo; command allows you to export a specific design from your Meshery server.
You can specify the design by its name or ID and optionally define the type of design.
The command also supports specifying an output directory where the exported design will be saved.
By default, the exported design will be saved in the current directory. The different types of design
type allowed are oci, original, and current. The default design type is current.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design export [pattern-name | ID] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Export a design with a specific ID</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design export [pattern-name | ID]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a design with a specific ID and type</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design export [pattern-name | ID] --type [design-type]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a design and save it to a specific directory</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design export [pattern-name | ID] --output ./designs

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a design with a specific type and save it to a directory</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design export [pattern-name | ID] --type [design-type] --output ./exports

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help            help for export
  -o, --output string   Specify the output directory to save the design
      --type string     Specify the design type to export

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-import">
	mesheryctl design import
</h1>
<p>Import a Meshery design</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<pre><code>	Import Helm Charts, Kubernetes Manifest, Docker Compose or Meshery designs by passing
	remote URL or local file system path to the file. Providing source type is optional.

	YAML and TGZ (with helm only) format of file is accepted, if you are importing Meshery Design OCI file format is also supported

	If you are providing remote URL, it should be a direct URL to a downloadable file.
	For example, if the file is stored on GitHub, the URL should be 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/path-to-file'.
</code></pre>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design import [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Import design manifest</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design import -f [file/URL] -s [source-type] -n [name]

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design import -f design.tar

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design import -f design.yml -n design-name

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design import -f design.yml -s "Kubernetes Manifest" -n design-name

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string          Path/URL to design file
  -h, --help                 help for import
  -n, --name string          Name for the design file
  -s, --source-type string   Type of source file (ex. manifest / compose / helm / design)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-design">
	mesheryctl design
</h1>
<p>Manage cloud native designs</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Manage cloud and cloud native infrastructure using predefined designs.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Apply design file:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design apply --file [path to design file | URL of the file]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Delete design file:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design delete --file [path to design file]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View design file:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design view [design name | ID]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List all designs:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help           help for design
  -t, --token string   Path to token file default from current context

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-apply</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/apply/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/apply/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-apply&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design apply&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Apply design file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Apply design will trigger deploy of the design file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design apply [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;apply a design file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design apply -f [file | URL]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;deploy a saved design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design apply [design-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -f, --file string   Path to design file&#xA;  -h, --help          help for apply&#xA;      --skip-save     Skip saving a design&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl design apply&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/patternApply.png&#34; alt=&#34;pattern-apply-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-delete</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/delete/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/delete/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-delete&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design delete&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete design file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;delete design file will trigger deletion of the design file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design delete [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;delete a design file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design delete [file | URL]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -f, --file string   Path to design file&#xA;  -h, --help          help for delete&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-deploy</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/deploy/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/deploy/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-deploy&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design deploy&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Deploy design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Command will trigger deploy of design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design deploy [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Deploy design by providing file path&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design deploy -f [filepath] -s [source type]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -f, --file string          Path to design file&#xA;  -h, --help                 help for deploy&#xA;      --skip-save            Skip saving a design&#xA;  -s, --source-type string   Type of source file (ex. manifest / compose / helm)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl design deploy&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/pattern-onboard.png&#34; alt=&#34;pattern-onboard-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-export</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/export/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/export/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-export&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design export&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Export a design from Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The &amp;rsquo;export&amp;rsquo; command allows you to export a specific design from your Meshery server.&#xA;You can specify the design by its name or ID and optionally define the type of design.&#xA;The command also supports specifying an output directory where the exported design will be saved.&#xA;By default, the exported design will be saved in the current directory. The different types of design&#xA;type allowed are oci, original, and current. The default design type is current.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-import</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/import/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/import/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-import&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design import&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import a Meshery design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;&#x9;Import Helm Charts, Kubernetes Manifest, Docker Compose or Meshery designs by passing&#xA;&#x9;remote URL or local file system path to the file. Providing source type is optional.&#xA;&#xA;&#x9;YAML and TGZ (with helm only) format of file is accepted, if you are importing Meshery Design OCI file format is also supported&#xA;&#xA;&#x9;If you are providing remote URL, it should be a direct URL to a downloadable file.&#xA;&#x9;For example, if the file is stored on GitHub, the URL should be &#39;https://raw.githubusercontent.com/path-to-file&#39;.&#xA;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design import [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import design manifest&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-list</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/list/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List designs&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display list of all available designs.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display a list of all available designs&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design list&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display a list of all available designs with verbose output&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design list --verbose&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display a list of all available designs with specified page number (10 designs per page by default)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design list --page [pange-number]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display a list of all available designs with custom page size (10 designs per page by default)&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-undeploy</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/undeploy/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/undeploy/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-undeploy&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design undeploy&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Undeploy design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Undeploy design will trigger undeploy of design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design undeploy [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Undeploy design by providing file path&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design undeploy -f [filepath]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -f, --file string   Path to design file&#xA;  -h, --help          help for undeploy&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-design-view</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/view/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/design/view/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-design-view&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl design view&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display a design content&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display the content of a specific design based on name or id&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design view design name [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;view a design&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl design view [design-name | ID]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -a, --all                    (optional) view all designs available&#xA;  -h, --help                   help for view&#xA;  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default &#34;yaml&#34;)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl design view&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/patternView.png&#34; alt=&#34;pattern-view-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-list">
	mesheryctl design list
</h1>
<p>List designs</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Display list of all available designs.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Display a list of all available designs</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display a list of all available designs with verbose output</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list --verbose

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display a list of all available designs with specified page number (10 designs per page by default)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list --page [pange-number]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display a list of all available designs with custom page size (10 designs per page by default)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list --pagesize [page-size]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display only the count of all available designs</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design list --count

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --count          (optional) Display count only
  -h, --help           help for list
  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of designs with --page (default 1)
      --pagesize int   (optional) Number of designs to be displayed per page (default 10)
  -v, --verbose        (optional) Display full length user identifiers and detailed timestamps

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl design list
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/patternList.png" alt="pattern-list-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-undeploy">
	mesheryctl design undeploy
</h1>
<p>Undeploy design</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Undeploy design will trigger undeploy of design</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design undeploy [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Undeploy design by providing file path</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design undeploy -f [filepath]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string   Path to design file
  -h, --help          help for undeploy

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-design-view">
	mesheryctl design view
</h1>
<p>Display a design content</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Display the content of a specific design based on name or id</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design view design name [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>view a design</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl design view [design-name | ID]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -a, --all                    (optional) view all designs available
  -h, --help                   help for view
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "yaml")

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl design view
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/patternView.png" alt="pattern-view-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-environment-create">
	mesheryctl environment create
</h1>
<p>Create a new environment</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Create a new environment by providing the name and description of the environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment create [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Create a new environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment create --orgID [orgID] --name [name] --description [description]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -d, --description string   Description of the environment
  -h, --help                 help for create
  -n, --name string          Name of the environment
  -o, --orgID string         Organization ID

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-environment-delete">
	mesheryctl environment delete
</h1>
<p>Delete an environment</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Delete an environment by providing the environment ID</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment delete [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>delete a new environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment delete [environmentId]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for delete

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-environment">
	mesheryctl environment
</h1>
<p>Manage environments</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Create, delete, list of view details of environment(s) of a specific organization</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Create an environment in an organization</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment create --orgID [orgID] --name [name] --description [description]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Delete an environment in an organization</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment delete environment-id

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List of registered environments in an organization</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a particular environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment view --orgID [orgID]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for environment

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

      <title>mesheryctl-environment-create</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/create/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/create/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-environment-create&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl environment create&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create a new environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create a new environment by providing the name and description of the environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment create [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create a new environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment create --orgID [orgID] --name [name] --description [description]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -d, --description string   Description of the environment&#xA;  -h, --help                 help for create&#xA;  -n, --name string          Name of the environment&#xA;  -o, --orgID string         Organization ID&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-environment-delete</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/delete/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/delete/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-environment-delete&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl environment delete&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete an environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete an environment by providing the environment ID&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment delete [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;delete a new environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment delete [environmentId]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for delete&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-environment-list</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/list/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-environment-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl environment list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List registered environments&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List detailed information of all registered environments&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all registered environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List count of all registered environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID] --count&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all registered environment at a specific page&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID] --page [page]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all registered environment with a specific page size&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-environment-view</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/view/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/environment/view/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-environment-view&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl environment view&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View registered environmnents&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View details of an environment registered in Meshery Server for a specific organization&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment view [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View details of a specific environment&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl environment view --orgID [orgID]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help                   help for view&#xA;      --orgID string           Organization ID&#xA;  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default &#34;yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -s, --save                   (optional) save output as a JSON/YAML file&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-environment-list">
	mesheryctl environment list
</h1>
<p>List registered environments</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List detailed information of all registered environments</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List all registered environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List count of all registered environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID] --count

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List all registered environment at a specific page</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID] --page [page]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List all registered environment with a specific page size</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment list --orgID [orgID] --pagesize [pagesize]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --count          (optional) Display count only
  -h, --help           help for list
      --orgID string   Organization ID
      --page int       (optional) Page number of paginated results (default 1)
      --pagesize int   (optional) Number of results per page (default 10)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>
