<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-environment-view">
	mesheryctl environment view
</h1>
<p>View registered environmnents</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>View details of an environment registered in Meshery Server for a specific organization</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment view [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>View details of a specific environment</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl environment view --orgID [orgID]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                   help for view
      --orgID string           Organization ID
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "yaml")
  -s, --save                   (optional) save output as a JSON/YAML file

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-exp">
	mesheryctl exp
</h1>
<p>Preview experimental commands</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Commands under the Experimental group are for testing and evaluation prior to promotion to general availability. Experimental commands are subject to change.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl exp [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for exp

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-filter-delete">
	mesheryctl filter delete
</h1>
<p>Delete a filter file</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Delete a filter file using the name or ID of a filter</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter delete [filter-name | ID] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Delete the specified WASM filter file using name or ID
A unique prefix of the name or ID can also be provided. If the prefix is not unique, the first match will be deleted.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter delete [filter-name | ID]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for delete

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-filter-import">
	mesheryctl filter import
</h1>
<p>Import a WASM filter</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Import a WASM filter from a URI (http/s) or local filesystem path</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter import [URI] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Import a filter file from local filesystem</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter import /path/to/filter.wasm

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import a filter file from a remote URI</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter import https://example.com/myfilter.wasm

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Add WASM configuration
If the string is a valid file in the filesystem, the file is read and passed as a string. Otherwise, the string is passed as is.
Use quotes if the string contains spaces</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter import /path/to/filter.wasm --wasm-config [filepath|string]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Specify the name of the filter to be imported. Use quotes if the name contains spaces</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter import /path/to/filter.wasm --name [string]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                 help for import
  -n, --name string          (optional) filter name
  -w, --wasm-config string   (optional) WASM configuration filepath/string

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-filter">
	mesheryctl filter
</h1>
<p>Manage WebAssembly filters</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Cloud Native Filter Management</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Base command for WASM filters:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter [subcommands]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help           help for filter
  -t, --token string   Path to token file default from current context

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>



<ul class="section-title">

</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-filter-delete</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/delete/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/delete/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-filter-delete&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl filter delete&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete a filter file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete a filter file using the name or ID of a filter&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter delete [filter-name | ID] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete the specified WASM filter file using name or ID&#xA;A unique prefix of the name or ID can also be provided. If the prefix is not unique, the first match will be deleted.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter delete [filter-name | ID]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for delete&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-filter-import</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/import/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/import/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-filter-import&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl filter import&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import a WASM filter&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import a WASM filter from a URI (http/s) or local filesystem path&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter import [URI] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import a filter file from local filesystem&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter import /path/to/filter.wasm&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import a filter file from a remote URI&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter import https://example.com/myfilter.wasm&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Add WASM configuration&#xA;If the string is a valid file in the filesystem, the file is read and passed as a string. Otherwise, the string is passed as is.&#xA;Use quotes if the string contains spaces&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-filter-list</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/list/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-filter-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl filter list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List filters&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display list of all available filter files.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all WASM filter files present&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter list&#x9;(maximum 25 filters)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search for filter&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter list Test (maximum 25 filters)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search for filter with space&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter list &#39;Test Filter&#39; (maximum 25 filters)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help       help for list&#xA;  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of filters with --page (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;  -v, --verbose    Display full length user and filter file identifiers&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-filter-view</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/view/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/filter/view/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-filter-view&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl filter view&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View filter(s)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Displays the contents of a specific filter based on name or id&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter view [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View the specified WASM filter&#xA;A unique prefix of the name or ID can also be provided. If the prefix is not unique, the first match will be returned.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter view &#34;[filter-name | ID]&#34;&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View all filter files&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl filter view --all&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View all filter files in json&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-filter-list">
	mesheryctl filter list
</h1>
<p>List filters</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Display list of all available filter files.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List all WASM filter files present</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter list	(maximum 25 filters)

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search for filter</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter list Test (maximum 25 filters)

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search for filter with space</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter list 'Test Filter' (maximum 25 filters)

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help       help for list
  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of filters with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
  -v, --verbose    Display full length user and filter file identifiers

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-filter-view">
	mesheryctl filter view
</h1>
<p>View filter(s)</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Displays the contents of a specific filter based on name or id</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter view [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>View the specified WASM filter
A unique prefix of the name or ID can also be provided. If the prefix is not unique, the first match will be returned.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter view "[filter-name | ID]"

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View all filter files</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter view --all

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View all filter files in json</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter view --all --output-format json

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View all filter files in json and save it to a file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter view --all --output-format json -s

</div>
</pre> 
<p>//View multi-word named filter files. Multi-word filter names should be enclosed in quotes</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl filter view "filter name"

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
        

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -a, --all                    (optional) view all filters available
  -h, --help                   help for view
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "yaml")
  -s, --save                   (optional) save output as a JSON/YAML file

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -t, --token string    Path to token file default from current context
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Command Line Reference</h1>
          
          
<h2 id="categories-and-command-structure">
	Categories and Command Structure
</h2>
<p>Meshery CLI commands are categorized by function, which are:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#global-commands-and-flags"><code>mesheryctl</code></a> - Global flags and CLI configuration</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-lifecycle-management-and-troubleshooting"><code>mesheryctl system</code></a> - Meshery Lifecycle and Troubleshooting</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#cloud-native-lifecycle-and-configuration-management"><code>mesheryctl adapter</code></a> - Lifecycle &amp; Configuration Management: provisioning and configuration best practices</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#cloud-native-performance-management"><code>mesheryctl perf</code></a> - Performance Management: Workload and cloud native performance characterization</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#cloud-native-design-configuration-and-management"><code>mesheryctl design</code></a> - Design Patterns: Cloud native patterns and best practices</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#data-plane-intelligence"><code>mesheryctl filter</code></a> - Data Plane Intelligence: Registry and configuration of WebAssembly filters for Envoy</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-models"><code>mesheryctl model</code></a> - A unit of packaging to define managed infrastructure and their relationships, and details specifics of how to manage them.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-components"><code>mesheryctl component</code></a> - Fundamental building block used to represent and define the infrastructure under management</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-registry-management"><code>mesheryctl registry</code></a> - Model Database: Manage the state and contents of Meshery&rsquo;s internal registry of capabilities.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-environment"><code>mesheryctl environment</code></a> - Logical group of connections and their associated credentials.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-connection"><code>mesheryctl connection</code></a> - Managed or unmanaged resources that either through discovery or manual entry are tracked by Meshery.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-organization"><code>mesheryctl organization</code></a> - Manage and interact with registered organizations.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-relationship"><code>mesheryctl relationship</code></a> - View and manage relationships registered in Meshery.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#meshery-workspace"><code>mesheryctl workspace</code></a> - View and manage workspaces under an organization.</li>
<li><a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/#experimental-featuresexp"><code>mesheryctl exp</code></a> - Experimental features</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

      <title>mesheryctl-completion</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/completion/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/completion/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-completion&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl completion&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate shell completion scripts&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Output shell completion code&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl completion [bash|zsh|fish]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;bash--32&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;bash &amp;lt;= 3.2&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;source /dev/stdin &lt;&lt;&lt; &#34;$(mesheryctl completion bash)&#34;&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;bash &amp;lt;= 3.2 on osx&#xA;ensure you have bash-completion 1.3+&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;brew install bash-completion &#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl completion bash &gt; $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/mesheryctl&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;bash--40&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;bash &amp;gt;= 4.0&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;source &lt;(mesheryctl completion bash)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;bash &amp;gt;= 4.0 on osx&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;brew install bash-completion@2&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl completion bash &gt; $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/mesheryctl&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;zsh&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;zsh&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need&#xA;to enable it.  You can execute the following once:&#xA;Might need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-exp</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/exp/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/exp/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-exp&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl exp&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Preview experimental commands&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Commands under the Experimental group are for testing and evaluation prior to promotion to general availability. Experimental commands are subject to change.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl exp [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for exp&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>

      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/version/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-version&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl version&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Show Meshery CLI and Server versions&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Version of Meshery command line client - mesheryctl.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl version [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;To view the current version and SHA of release binary of mesheryctl client&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl version&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for version&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl version&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/version.png&#34; alt=&#34;version-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-build">
	mesheryctl model build
</h1>
<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files.
Model files are taken from [path]/[model-name]/[model-version] folder.
Expects input to be in the format scaffolded by the model init command.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model build [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model build [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model build [model-name]/[model-version]

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
    

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help          help for build
  -p, --path string   (optional) target directory to get model from (default: current dir) (default ".")

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-delete">
	mesheryctl model delete
</h1>
<p>Delete a model</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Delete a model by ID or Name</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model delete [model-id | model-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Delete a model by ID</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model delete [model-id]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Delete a model by name</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model delete [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for delete

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-export">
	mesheryctl model export
</h1>
<p>Export registered models</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Export the registered model to the specified output type</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Export a model by name</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [model-name] -o [oci|tar]  (default is oci)

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a model by name in JSON type</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [model-name] -t [yaml|json] (default is YAML)

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a model by name in YAML type in a specific location</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [model-name] -l [path-to-location]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a model by name in YAML type discarding components and relationships</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [model-name] --discard-components --discard-relationships

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export a model version by name in YAML type</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [model-name] --version [version (ex: v0.7.3)]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --discard-components       (optional) whether to discard components in the exported model definition (default = false)
  -r, --discard-relationships    (optional) whether to discard relationships in the exported model definition (default = false)
  -h, --help                     help for export
  -t, --output-format string     (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default = yaml) (default "yaml")
  -l, --output-location string   (optional) output location (default = current directory) (default "./")
  -o, --output-type string       (optional) format to display in [oci|tar] (default = oci) (default "oci")
  -p, --page int                 (optional) page number for paginated results (default = 1) (default 1)
      --version string           (optional) model version to export (default = "", format: vX.X.X)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-generate">
	mesheryctl model generate
</h1>
<p>Generate models from a file</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Generate models by specifying the directory, file, or URL. You can also provide a template JSON file and registrant name</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model generate [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Generate a model from a CSV directory</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model generate --f [path-to-csv-directory]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate a model from a URL based on a JSON template</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model generate --f [URL] -t [path-to-template.json]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate a model from a URL based on a JSON template skipping registration</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model generate --f [URL] -t [path-to-template.json] -r

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string       Specify path to the file or directory
  -h, --help              help for generate
  -r, --register          Skip registration of the model
  -t, --template string   Specify path to the template JSON file

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-import">
	mesheryctl model import
</h1>
<p>Import models</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Import models by specifying the directory, file, or URL. You can also provide a template JSON file and registrant name</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Import model</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import --file [URI]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import model from a URL to a meshery model</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import --file [URL]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import model from an OCI artifact</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import --file [OCI]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import model from a tar.gz file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import --file [path-to-model.tar.gz]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import model from a path</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import --file [path-to-model]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import model using CSV files</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import --file [path-to-csv-directory]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -f, --file string   Specify path to the file or directory
  -h, --help          help for import

</div>
</pre>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-model">
	mesheryctl model
</h1>
<p>Manage models in the registery</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Export, generate, import, list, search and view model(s) and detailed informations</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Display number of available models in Meshery</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model --count

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Export registered models</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model export [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate a model from a CSV directory</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model generate [path-to-csv-directory]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate a model from a URL based on a JSON template</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model generate --file [URL] --template [path-to-template.json]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Import model(s)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model import -f [Uri]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List available model(s)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model list

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Delete available model(s)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model delete [model-id]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search for a specific model</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model search [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a specific model</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model view [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Scaffold a folder structure for model creation</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model init [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model build [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model build [model-name]/[model-version]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --count   (optional) Get the number of models in total
  -h, --help    help for model

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">

</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>
