</div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-build</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/build/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/build/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-build&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model build&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files.&#xA;Model files are taken from [path]/[model-name]/[model-version] folder.&#xA;Expects input to be in the format scaffolded by the model init command.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model build [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create an OCI-compliant package from the model files&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model build [model-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model build [model-name]/[model-version]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;    &#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help          help for build&#xA;  -p, --path string   (optional) target directory to get model from (default: current dir) (default &#34;.&#34;)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-delete</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/delete/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/delete/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-delete&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model delete&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete a model&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete a model by ID or Name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model delete [model-id | model-name] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete a model by ID&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model delete [model-id]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete a model by name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model delete [model-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for delete&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-export</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/export/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/export/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-export&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model export&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Export registered models&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Export the registered model to the specified output type&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model export [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Export a model by name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model export [model-name] -o [oci|tar]  (default is oci)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Export a model by name in JSON type&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model export [model-name] -t [yaml|json] (default is YAML)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Export a model by name in YAML type in a specific location&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-generate</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/generate/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/generate/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-generate&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model generate&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate models from a file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate models by specifying the directory, file, or URL. You can also provide a template JSON file and registrant name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model generate [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate a model from a CSV directory&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model generate --f [path-to-csv-directory]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate a model from a URL based on a JSON template&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model generate --f [URL] -t [path-to-template.json]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate a model from a URL based on a JSON template skipping registration&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-import</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/import/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/import/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-import&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model import&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import models&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import models by specifying the directory, file, or URL. You can also provide a template JSON file and registrant name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model import [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import model&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model import --file [URI]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import model from a URL to a meshery model&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model import --file [URL]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import model from an OCI artifact&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model import --file [OCI]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Import model from a tar.gz file&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-init</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/init/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/init/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-init&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model init&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generates scaffolding for convenient model creation&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generates a folder structure and guides user on model creation&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model init [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;generates a folder structure&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model init [model-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;generates a folder structure and sets up model version&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model init [model-name] --version [version] (default is v0.1.0)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;generates a folder structure under specified path&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model init [model-name] --path [path-to-location] (default is current folder)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;generate a folder structure in json format&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-list</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/list/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List registered models&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all registered models by pagingation (10 models per page)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List of models&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model list&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List of models for a specified page&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model list --page [page-number] --pagesize [pagesize]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display number of available models in Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model list --count&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;    &#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -c, --count          (optional) Get the number of models in total&#xA;  -h, --help           help for list&#xA;  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of models with --page (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) List next set of models with --pagesize (default = 10) (default 10)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-search</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/search/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/search/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-search&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model search&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search model(s)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search model(s) by search string&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model search [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search model from current provider&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model search [query-text]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search list of models for a specified page&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model search [query-text] --page [page-number]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search list of models for a specified pagesize&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model search [query-text] --pagesize [pagesize-number]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help           help for search&#xA;  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of models with --page (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) List next set of models with --pagesize (default = 10) (default 10)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-model-view</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/view/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/model/view/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-model-view&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl model view&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View model&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View a model queried by its name or ID&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model view [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View a specific model from current provider by using [model-name] or [model-id] in default format yaml&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model view [model-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View a specific model in specifed format&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl model view [model-name] --output-format [json|yaml]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View a specific model in specified format and save it as a file&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-init">
	mesheryctl model init
</h1>
<p>Generates scaffolding for convenient model creation</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Generates a folder structure and guides user on model creation</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model init [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>generates a folder structure</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model init [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>generates a folder structure and sets up model version</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model init [model-name] --version [version] (default is v0.1.0)

</div>
</pre> 
<p>generates a folder structure under specified path</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model init [model-name] --path [path-to-location] (default is current folder)

</div>
</pre> 
<p>generate a folder structure in json format</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model init [model-name] --output-format [json|yaml|csv] (default is json)

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
    

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                   help for init
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "json")
  -p, --path string            (optional) target directory (default: current dir) (default ".")
      --version string         (optional) model version (default: v0.1.0) (default "v0.1.0")

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-list">
	mesheryctl model list
</h1>
<p>List registered models</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List all registered models by pagingation (10 models per page)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List of models</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model list

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List of models for a specified page</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model list --page [page-number] --pagesize [pagesize]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display number of available models in Meshery</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model list --count

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
    

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --count          (optional) Get the number of models in total
  -h, --help           help for list
  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of models with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) List next set of models with --pagesize (default = 10) (default 10)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-search">
	mesheryctl model search
</h1>
<p>Search model(s)</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Search model(s) by search string</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model search [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Search model from current provider</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model search [query-text]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search list of models for a specified page</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model search [query-text] --page [page-number]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search list of models for a specified pagesize</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model search [query-text] --pagesize [pagesize-number]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help           help for search
  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of models with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) List next set of models with --pagesize (default = 10) (default 10)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-model-view">
	mesheryctl model view
</h1>
<p>View model</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>View a model queried by its name or ID</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model view [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>View a specific model from current provider by using [model-name] or [model-id] in default format yaml</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model view [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a specific model in specifed format</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model view [model-name] --output-format [json|yaml]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a specific model in specified format and save it as a file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl model view [model-name] --output-format [json|yaml] --save

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                   help for view
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "yaml")
  -s, --save                   (optional) save output as a JSON/YAML file

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-organization">
	mesheryctl organization
</h1>
<p>Interact with registered organizations</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Interact with registered organizations to display detailed information</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Number of  registered orgs</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization --count

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List registerd orgs</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization list

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --count   total number of registered organizations
  -h, --help    help for organization

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/organization/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-organization-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl organization list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List registered organizations&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all registered organizations with their id, name and date of creation. Organization will be returned based on provider you logged in.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl organization list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;list all organizations&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl organization list&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;list organizations for a specified page&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl organization list --page [page-number]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display number of available organizations&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl organization list --count&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --count          total number of registered orgs&#xA;  -h, --help           help for list&#xA;  -p, --page int       (optional) Page number of paginated results (default 1)&#xA;  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) Number of organizations per page (default 10)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt;         <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-organization-list">
	mesheryctl organization list
</h1>
<p>List registered organizations</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List all registered organizations with their id, name and date of creation. Organization will be returned based on provider you logged in.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>list all organizations</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization list

</div>
</pre> 
<p>list organizations for a specified page</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization list --page [page-number]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display number of available organizations</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl organization list --count

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --count          total number of registered orgs
  -h, --help           help for list
  -p, --page int       (optional) Page number of paginated results (default 1)
  -s, --pagesize int   (optional) Number of organizations per page (default 10)

</div>
</pre>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf-apply">
	mesheryctl perf apply
</h1>
<p>Run a Performance test</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Run Performance test using existing profiles or using flags</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply [profile-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Execute a Performance test with the specified performance profile</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Execute a Performance test with creating a new performance profile</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com"

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Execute a Performance test creating a new performance profile and pass certificate to be used</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --cert-path path/to/cert.pem

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Execute a performance profile without using the certificate present in the profile</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --url "https://google.com" --disable-cert

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Run Performance test using SMP compatible test configuration
If the profile already exists, the test will be run overriding the values with the ones provided in the configuration file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile -f path/to/perf-config.yaml

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Run performance test using SMP compatible test configuration and override values with flags</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile -f path/to/perf-config.yaml [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Choice of load generator - fortio, wrk2 or nighthawk (default: fortio)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --load-generator wrk2

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Execute a Performance test with specified queries per second</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --url https://192.168.1.15/productpage --qps 30

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Execute a Performance test with specified infrastructure</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile --url https://192.168.1.15/productpage --mesh istio

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Execute a Performance test creating a new performance profile and pass options to the load generator used
If any options are already present in the profile or passed through flags, the &ndash;options flag will take precedence over the profile and flag options
Options for nighthawk - <a href="https://github.com/meshery-extensions/getnighthawk/blob/v1.0.5/pkg/proto/options.pb.go#L882-L1018">https://github.com/meshery-extensions/getnighthawk/blob/v1.0.5/pkg/proto/options.pb.go#L882-L1018</a>
Options for fortio - <a href="https://github.com/fortio/fortio/blob/v1.57.0/fhttp/httprunner.go#L77-L84">https://github.com/fortio/fortio/blob/v1.57.0/fhttp/httprunner.go#L77-L84</a>
Options for wrk2 - <a href="https://github.com/meshery-extensions/gowrk2/blob/v0.6.1/api/gowrk2.go#L47-L53">https://github.com/meshery-extensions/gowrk2/blob/v0.6.1/api/gowrk2.go#L47-L53</a></p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --options [filepath|json-string]

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --options path/to/options.json

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --load-generator nighthawk --options '{"requests_per_second": 10, "max_pending_requests": 5}'

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --load-generator fortio --options '{"MethodOverride": "POST"}'

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url "https://google.com" --load-generator wrk2 --options '{"DurationInSeconds": 15, "Thread": 3}'

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -b, --body string                  (optional) Load test body. Can be a filepath/string
      --cert-path string             (optional) Path to the certificate to be used for the load test
      --concurrent-requests string   (optional) Number of Parallel Requests
      --disable-cert                 (optional) Do not use certificate present in the profile
      --duration string              (optional) Length of test (e.g. 10s, 5m, 2h). For more, see https://golang.org/pkg/time/#ParseDuration
  -f, --file string                  (optional) File containing SMP-compatible test configuration. For more, see https://github.com/service-mesh-performance/service-mesh-performance-specification
  -h, --help                         help for apply
      --load-generator string        (optional) Load-Generator to be used (fortio/wrk2/nighthawk)
      --mesh string                  (optional) Name of the infrastructure
      --name string                  (optional) Name of the Test
      --options string               (optional) Additional options to be passed to the load generator. Can be a json string or a filepath containing json
      --qps string                   (optional) Queries per second
      --url string                   (optional) Endpoint URL to test (required with --profile)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string          path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -v, --verbose                verbose output
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl perf apply
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/perf-apply.png" alt="perf-apply-usage"  /></p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-perf">
	mesheryctl perf
</h1>
<p>Run performance tests</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Load generation and performance characterization</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Run performance test:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf apply test-3 --name "a quick stress test" --url http://192.168.1.15/productpage --qps 300 --concurrent-requests 2 --duration 30s

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List performance profiles:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf profile sam-test

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List performance results:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result sam-test

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display Perf profile in JSON or YAML:</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result -o json

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result -o yaml

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                   help for perf
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-perf-apply</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/perf/apply/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/perf/apply/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-perf-apply&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl perf apply&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run a Performance test&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run Performance test using existing profiles or using flags&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf apply [profile-name] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Execute a Performance test with the specified performance profile&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Execute a Performance test with creating a new performance profile&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf apply meshery-profile-new --url &#34;https://google.com&#34;&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Execute a Performance test creating a new performance profile and pass certificate to be used&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-perf-profile</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/perf/profile/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/perf/profile/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-perf-profile&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl perf profile&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List performance profiles&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all the available performance profiles&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf profile [profile-name] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List performance profiles (maximum 25 profiles)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf profile&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List performance profiles with search (maximum 25 profiles)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf profile test 2&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View single performance profile with detailed information&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf profile test --view&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help       help for profile&#xA;  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of performance results with --page (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;      --view       (optional) View single performance profile with more info&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string          path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]&#xA;  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config&#xA;  -v, --verbose                verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-perf-result</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/perf/result/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/perf/result/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-perf-result&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl perf result&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List performance test results&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all the available test results of a performance profile&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf result [profile-name] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List Test results (maximum 25 results)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View other set of performance results with &amp;ndash;page (maximum 25 results)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile --page 2&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View single performance result with detailed information&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile --view&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help       help for result&#xA;  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of performance results with --page (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;      --view       (optional) View single performance results with more info&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string          path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]&#xA;  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config&#xA;  -v, --verbose                verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl perf result&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/perf-result.png&#34; alt=&#34;perf-result-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf-profile">
	mesheryctl perf profile
</h1>
<p>List performance profiles</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List all the available performance profiles</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf profile [profile-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List performance profiles (maximum 25 profiles)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf profile

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List performance profiles with search (maximum 25 profiles)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf profile test 2

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View single performance profile with detailed information</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf profile test --view

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help       help for profile
  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of performance results with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
      --view       (optional) View single performance profile with more info

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string          path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -v, --verbose                verbose output
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-perf-result">
	mesheryctl perf result
</h1>
<p>List performance test results</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List all the available test results of a performance profile</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result [profile-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List Test results (maximum 25 results)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View other set of performance results with &ndash;page (maximum 25 results)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile --page 2

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View single performance result with detailed information</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl perf result saturday-profile --view

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help       help for result
  -p, --page int   (optional) List next set of performance results with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
      --view       (optional) View single performance results with more info

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string          path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml]
  -t, --token string           (required) Path to meshery auth config
  -v, --verbose                verbose output
  -y, --yes                    (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl perf result
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/perf-result.png" alt="perf-result-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>
