<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry-generate">
	mesheryctl registry generate
</h1>
<p>Generate Models</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Prerequisite: Excecute this command from the root of a meshery/meshery repo fork.\n\nGiven a Google Sheet with a list of model names and source locations, generate models and components any Registrant (e.g. GitHub, Artifact Hub) repositories.\n\nGenerated Model files are written to local filesystem under &ldquo;/server/models/<model-name>&rdquo;.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Generate Meshery Models from a Google Spreadsheet (i.e. &ldquo;Meshery Integrations&rdquo; spreadsheet).</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED"

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Directly generate models from one of the supported registrants by using Registrant Connection Definition and (optional) Registrant Credential Definition</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --registrant-def [path to connection definition] --registrant-cred [path to credential definition]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate a specific Model from a Google Spreadsheet (i.e. &ldquo;Meshery Integrations&rdquo; spreadsheet).</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred --model "[model-name]"

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate Meshery Models and Component from csv files in a local directory.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --directory [DIRECTORY_PATH]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate Meshery Models from individual CSV files.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --model-csv [path/to/models.csv] --component-csv [path/to/components.csv] --relationship-csv [path/to/relationships.csv]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate models with a custom per-model timeout (e.g., 10 minutes per model).</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" --timeout 10m

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate only the latest version of each model.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry generate --spreadsheet-id "1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw" --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" --latest-only

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --component-csv string      path to the component CSV file
  -d, --directory string          Directory containing the Model and Component CSV files
  -h, --help                      help for generate
      --latest-only               generate only the latest version of each model
  -m, --model string              specific model name to be generated
      --model-csv string          path to the model CSV file
  -o, --output string             location to output generated models, defaults to ../server/meshmodels (default "../server/meshmodel")
      --registrant-cred string    path pointing to the registrant credential definition
      --registrant-def string     path pointing to the registrant connection definition
      --relationship-csv string   path to the relationship CSV file (optional)
      --spreadsheet-cred string   base64 encoded credential to download the spreadsheet
      --spreadsheet-id string     spreadsheet ID for the integration spreadsheet
      --timeout duration          timeout duration for generating each model (e.g., 5m, 10m, 1h), default: 5m (default 5m0s)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-registry">
	mesheryctl registry
</h1>
<p>Manage the capability registry</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Manage the state and contents of Meshery’s internal registry of capabilities.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry [subcommand]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for registry

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>



<ul class="section-title">

  

  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/generate/">mesheryctl-registry-generate</a>

        
      </li>

        <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/update/">mesheryctl-registry-update</a>

        
      </li>
    
  

</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-registry-generate</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/generate/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/generate/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-registry-generate&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl registry generate&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate Models&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Prerequisite: Excecute this command from the root of a meshery/meshery repo fork.\n\nGiven a Google Sheet with a list of model names and source locations, generate models and components any Registrant (e.g. GitHub, Artifact Hub) repositories.\n\nGenerated Model files are written to local filesystem under &amp;ldquo;/server/models/&lt;model-name&gt;&amp;rdquo;.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl registry generate [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate Meshery Models from a Google Spreadsheet (i.e. &amp;ldquo;Meshery Integrations&amp;rdquo; spreadsheet).&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-registry-publish</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/publish/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/publish/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-registry-publish&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl registry publish&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Publish Meshery Models to Websites, Remote Provider, Meshery Server&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Publishes metadata about Meshery Models to Websites, Remote Provider, or Meshery Server, including model and component icons by reading from a Google Spreadsheet and outputing to markdown or json format.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl registry publish [system] [google-sheet-credential] [sheet-id] [models-output-path] [imgs-output-path] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Publish To System&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl registry publish [system] [google-sheet-credential] [sheet-id] [models-output-path] [imgs-output-path] -o [output-format]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Publish To Meshery&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-registry-update</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/update/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/registry/update/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-registry-update&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl registry update&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Update the registry with latest data.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Updates the component metadata (SVGs, shapes, styles and other) by referring from a Google Spreadsheet.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl registry update [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Update models from Meshery Integration Spreadsheet&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id [id] --spreadsheet-cred &#34;$CRED&#34; -i [path to the directory containing models].&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Updating models in the meshery/meshery repository based on the spreadsheet&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw --spreadsheet-cred &#34;$CRED&#34;&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Updating models in the meshery/meshery repository based on flag&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry-publish">
	mesheryctl registry publish
</h1>
<p>Publish Meshery Models to Websites, Remote Provider, Meshery Server</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Publishes metadata about Meshery Models to Websites, Remote Provider, or Meshery Server, including model and component icons by reading from a Google Spreadsheet and outputing to markdown or json format.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish [system] [google-sheet-credential] [sheet-id] [models-output-path] [imgs-output-path] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Publish To System</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish [system] [google-sheet-credential] [sheet-id] [models-output-path] [imgs-output-path] -o [output-format]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Publish To Meshery</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish meshery GoogleCredential GoogleSheetID [repo]/server/meshmodel

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Publish To Remote Provider</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish remote-provider GoogleCredential GoogleSheetID [repo]/meshmodels/models [repo]/ui/public/img/meshmodels

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Publish To Website</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish website GoogleCredential GoogleSheetID [repo]/integrations [repo]/ui/public/img/meshmodels

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Publishing to meshery docs</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
cd docs;

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish website "$CRED" 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw docs/pages/integrations docs/assets/img/integrations -o md

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Publishing to mesheryio site</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish website "$CRED" 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw meshery.io/integrations meshery.io/assets/images/integration -o js

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Publishing to any website</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry publish website "$CRED" 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw path/to/models path/to/icons -o mdx

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                   help for publish
  -o, --output-format string   output format [md | mdx | js]

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-registry-update">
	mesheryctl registry update
</h1>
<p>Update the registry with latest data.</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Updates the component metadata (SVGs, shapes, styles and other) by referring from a Google Spreadsheet.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry update [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Update models from Meshery Integration Spreadsheet</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id [id] --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" -i [path to the directory containing models].

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Updating models in the meshery/meshery repository based on the spreadsheet</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED"

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Updating models in the meshery/meshery repository based on flag</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl registry update --spreadsheet-id 1DZHnzxYWOlJ69Oguz4LkRVTFM79kC2tuvdwizOJmeMw --spreadsheet-cred "$CRED" --model "[model-name]"

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                      help for update
  -i, --input string              relative or absolute input path to the models directory (default "../server/meshmodel")
  -m, --model string              specific model name to be generated
      --spreadsheet-cred string   base64 encoded credential to download the spreadsheet
      --spreadsheet-id string     spreadsheet it for the integration spreadsheet

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-relationship-generate">
	mesheryctl relationship generate
</h1>
<p>Generate relationships documents</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Generate relationships documents from the google spreadsheets</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship generate [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Generate relationships documentss</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship generate --spreadsheet-id [Spreadsheet ID] --spreadsheet-cred $CRED

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                      help for generate
      --spreadsheet-cred string   base64 encoded credential to download the spreadsheet
      --spreadsheet-id string     spreadsheet ID for the integration spreadsheet

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-relationship">
	mesheryctl relationship
</h1>
<p>Manage relationships</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Generate, list, search and view relationship(s) and detailed information
Meshery uses relationships to define how interconnected components interact.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Display number of available relationships in Meshery</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship --count

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Generate a relationship documentation</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship generate [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List available relationship(s)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search for a specific relationship</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship search [--kind <kind>] [--type <type>] [--subtype <subtype>] [--model <model>]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a specific relationship</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship view [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --count   (optional) Get the number of relationship(s) in total
  -h, --help    help for relationship

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-relationship-generate</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/generate/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/generate/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-relationship-generate&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl relationship generate&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate relationships documents&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate relationships documents from the google spreadsheets&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship generate [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Generate relationships documentss&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship generate --spreadsheet-id [Spreadsheet ID] --spreadsheet-cred $CRED&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help                      help for generate&#xA;      --spreadsheet-cred string   base64 encoded credential to download the spreadsheet&#xA;      --spreadsheet-id string     spreadsheet ID for the integration spreadsheet&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-relationship-list</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/list/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-relationship-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl relationship list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List registered relationships&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all relationships registered in Meshery Server&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all relationships&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship list&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List relationships for a specified page&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship list --page [page-number]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;List relationships with a custom page size&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship list --pagesize [page-size]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display the total number of available relationships in Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship list --count&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -c, --count          (optional) Display the total count of relationships only&#xA;  -h, --help           help for list&#xA;  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of relationships with --page (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;      --pagesize int   (optional) Number of results per page (default = 10) (default 10)&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-relationship-search</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/search/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/search/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-relationship-search&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl relationship search&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search registered relationship(s)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search registered relationship(s) used by different models&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship search [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search for a specific relationship&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship search [--kind &lt;kind&gt;] [--type &lt;type&gt;] [--subtype &lt;subtype&gt;] [--model &lt;model&gt;]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Search a relationship for a specified page&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship search [--kind &lt;kind&gt;] [--page &lt;int&gt;]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help             help for search&#xA;  -k, --kind string      (optional) Search relationships of a particular kind&#xA;  -m, --model string     (optional) Search relationships of a particular model name&#xA;  -p, --page int         (optional) Page number of results to fetch (default = 1) (default 1)&#xA;  -s, --subtype string   (optional) Search relationships of a particular subtype&#xA;  -t, --type string      (optional) Search relationships of a particular type&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string   path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -v, --verbose         verbose output&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-relationship-view</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/view/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/relationship/view/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-relationship-view&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl relationship view&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;view relationships of a model by its name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;view a relationship queried by the model name&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship view [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View relationships of a model in default format yaml&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship view [model-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View relationships of a model in JSON format&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl relationship view [model-name] --output-format json&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View relationships of a model in json format and save it to a file&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-relationship-list">
	mesheryctl relationship list
</h1>
<p>List registered relationships</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List all relationships registered in Meshery Server</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List all relationships</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship list

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List relationships for a specified page</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship list --page [page-number]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>List relationships with a custom page size</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship list --pagesize [page-size]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Display the total number of available relationships in Meshery</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship list --count

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --count          (optional) Display the total count of relationships only
  -h, --help           help for list
  -p, --page int       (optional) List next set of relationships with --page (default = 1) (default 1)
      --pagesize int   (optional) Number of results per page (default = 10) (default 10)

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-relationship-search">
	mesheryctl relationship search
</h1>
<p>Search registered relationship(s)</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Search registered relationship(s) used by different models</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship search [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Search for a specific relationship</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship search [--kind <kind>] [--type <type>] [--subtype <subtype>] [--model <model>]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Search a relationship for a specified page</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship search [--kind <kind>] [--page <int>]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help             help for search
  -k, --kind string      (optional) Search relationships of a particular kind
  -m, --model string     (optional) Search relationships of a particular model name
  -p, --page int         (optional) Page number of results to fetch (default = 1) (default 1)
  -s, --subtype string   (optional) Search relationships of a particular subtype
  -t, --type string      (optional) Search relationships of a particular type

</div>
</pre>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-relationship-view">
	mesheryctl relationship view
</h1>
<p>view relationships of a model by its name</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>view a relationship queried by the model name</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship view [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>View relationships of a model in default format yaml</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship view [model-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View relationships of a model in JSON format</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship view [model-name] --output-format json

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View relationships of a model in json format and save it to a file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl relationship view [model-name] --output-format json --save

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help                   help for view
  -o, --output-format string   (optional) format to display in [json|yaml] (default "yaml")
  -s, --save                   (optional) save output as a JSON/YAML file

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel">
	mesheryctl system channel
</h1>
<p>Switch between release channels</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Subscribe to a release channel. Choose between either &lsquo;stable&rsquo; or &rsquo;edge&rsquo; channels.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Subscribe to release channel or version</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel

</div>
</pre> 
<p>To set the channel</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel set [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>To pin/set the channel to a specific version</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel set stable-v0.6.0

</div>
</pre> 
<p>To view release channel and version</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel view

</div>
</pre> 
<p>To switch release channel and version</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for channel

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

</h2>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

 -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt;       <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-channel-switch&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system channel switch&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;switch release channel and version&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Switch release channel and version of context in focus&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Switch between release channels&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for switch&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;         <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel-set">
	mesheryctl system channel set
</h1>
<p>set release channel and version</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Set release channel and version of context in focus</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel set [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Subscribe to release channel or version</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel set [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for set

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel-switch">
	mesheryctl system channel switch
</h1>
<p>switch release channel and version</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Switch release channel and version of context in focus</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Switch between release channels</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel switch [stable|stable-version|edge|edge-version]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for switch

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-channel-view">
	mesheryctl system channel view
</h1>
<p>view release channel and version</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>View release channel and version of context in focus</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel view [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>View current release channel</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel view edge

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View release channel for all contexts</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system channel view --all

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -a, --all    Show release channel for all contexts
  -h, --help   help for view

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>

  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
