          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-check">
	mesheryctl system check
</h1>
<p>Pre-deployment and post-deployment healthchecks for Meshery</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Verify environment pre/post-deployment of Meshery.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Run all system checks for both pre and post-deployment scenarios</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Run pre-deployment checks (Docker and Kubernetes)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check --preflight

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Run pre-deployment checks (Docker and Kubernetes)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check --pre

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Run checks for all Meshery adapters</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check --adapters

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Run checks on a specific Meshery adapter</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check --adapter meshery-istio:10000

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check --adapter meshery-istio

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Verify the health of Meshery Operator&rsquo;s deployment with MeshSync and Broker</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system check --operator

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --adapter string   Check status of specified meshery adapter
      --adapters         Check status of meshery adapters
      --components       Check status of Meshery components
  -h, --help             help for check
      --operator         Verify the health of Meshery Operator's deployment with MeshSync and Broker
      --pre              Verify environment readiness to deploy Meshery
      --preflight        Verify environment readiness to deploy Meshery

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl system check
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/check.png" alt="check-usage"  /></p>

</h2>

<script>

        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';

            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-create">
	mesheryctl system context create
</h1>
<p>Create a new context (a named Meshery deployment)</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Add a new context to Meshery config.yaml file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context create context-name [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Create new context</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context create [context-name]

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Create new context and provide list of components, platform &amp; URL</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context create context-name --components meshery-nsm --platform docker --url http://localhost:9081 --set --yes

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -a, --components stringArray   List of components
  -h, --help                     help for create
  -p, --platform string          Platform to deploy Meshery
      --provider string          Provider to use with the Meshery server
  -s, --set                      Set as current context
  -u, --url string               Meshery Server URL with Port

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl context create
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/newcontext.png" alt="context-create-usage"  /></p>

	See Also
</h2>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-delete">
	mesheryctl system context delete
</h1>
<p>Delete context</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Delete an existing context (a named Meshery deployment) from Meshery config file</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context delete [context-name] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<h3 id="delete-context">
	Delete context
</h3>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context delete [context name]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help         help for delete
  -s, --set string   New context to deploy Meshery

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context">
	mesheryctl system context
</h1>
<p>Configure your Meshery deployment(s)</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Configure and switch between different named Meshery server and component versions and deployments.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context [command] [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Base command</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -h, --help             help for context

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output
  -y, --yes             (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-context-create</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/create/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/create/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-context-create&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system context create&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create a new context (a named Meshery deployment)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Add a new context to Meshery config.yaml file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context create context-name [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create new context&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context create [context-name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Create new context and provide list of components, platform &amp;amp; URL&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context create context-name --components meshery-nsm --platform docker --url http://localhost:9081 --set --yes&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -a, --components stringArray   List of components&#xA;  -h, --help                     help for create&#xA;  -p, --platform string          Platform to deploy Meshery&#xA;      --provider string          Provider to use with the Meshery server&#xA;  -s, --set                      Set as current context&#xA;  -u, --url string               Meshery Server URL with Port&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl context create&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/newcontext.png&#34; alt=&#34;context-create-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-context-delete</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/delete/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/delete/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-context-delete&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system context delete&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete context&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete an existing context (a named Meshery deployment) from Meshery config file&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context delete [context-name] [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;delete-context&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Delete context&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context delete [context name]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help         help for delete&#xA;  -s, --set string   New context to deploy Meshery&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-context-list</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/list/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/list/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-context-list&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system context list&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;list contexts&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List current context and available contexts&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context list [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;List all contexts present&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context list&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for list&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-context-switch</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/switch/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/switch/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-context-switch&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system context switch&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;switch context&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Configure mesheryctl to actively use one one context vs. another context&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context switch context-name [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Switch to context named &amp;ldquo;sample&amp;rdquo;&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context switch sample&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for switch&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl context switch&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/contextswitch.png&#34; alt=&#34;context-switch-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-context-view</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/view/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/context/view/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-context-view&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system context view&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display the current Meshery CLI configuration context&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Display the current Meshery CLI context configuration.&#xA;This command shows which Kubernetes cluster, platform, and provider Meshery is configured to communicate with.&#xA;Use this to verify or debug your current CLI settings.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context view [context-name | --context context-name | --all] --flags [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;View the default context&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system context view&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;View a specified context&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-list">
	mesheryctl system context list
</h1>
<p>list contexts</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>List current context and available contexts</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context list [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>List all contexts present</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context list

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for list

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-switch">
	mesheryctl system context switch
</h1>
<p>switch context</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Configure mesheryctl to actively use one one context vs. another context</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context switch context-name [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Switch to context named &ldquo;sample&rdquo;</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context switch sample

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for switch

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl context switch
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/contextswitch.png" alt="context-switch-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-context-view">
	mesheryctl system context view
</h1>
<p>Display the current Meshery CLI configuration context</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Display the current Meshery CLI context configuration.
This command shows which Kubernetes cluster, platform, and provider Meshery is configured to communicate with.
Use this to verify or debug your current CLI settings.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context view [context-name | --context context-name | --all] --flags [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>View the default context</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context view

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a specified context</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context view context-name

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View a specified context using the &ndash;context flag</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context view --context context-name

</div>
</pre> 
<p>View configuration of all contexts</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system context view --all

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
    

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --all              Show configs for all of the context
  -c, --context string   Show config for the context
  -h, --help             help for view

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output
  -y, --yes             (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="screenshots">
	Screenshots
</h2>
<p>Usage of mesheryctl context view
<img class="content-image" src="/reference/images/context-view.png" alt="context-view-usage"  /></p>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-dashboard">
	mesheryctl system dashboard
</h1>
<p>Open Meshery UI in browser.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system dashboard [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Open Meshery UI in browser</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system dashboard

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Open Meshery UI in browser and use port-forwarding (if default port is taken already)</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Open Meshery UI in browser and use port-forwarding, listen on port 9081 locally, forwarding traffic to meshery server in the pod</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward -p 9081

</div>
</pre> 
<p>(optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system dashboard --skip-browser

</div>
</pre> 
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
Note: Meshery's web-based user interface is embedded in Meshery Server and is available as soon as Meshery starts. The location and port that Meshery UI is exposed varies depending upon your mode of deployment. See accessing \"Meshery UI\" for additional deployment-specific options: https://docs.meshery.io/installation/accessing-meshery-ui.

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help           help for dashboard
  -p, --port int       (optional) Local port that is not in use from which traffic is to be forwarded to the server running inside the Pod. (default 9081)
      --port-forward   (optional) Use port forwarding to access Meshery UI
      --skip-browser   (optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

          <h1 id="mesheryctl-system-delete">
	mesheryctl system delete
</h1>
<p>Delete Meshery containers</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Delete Meshery containers. This command removes all Meshery containers created by docker-compose.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system delete [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="examples">
	Examples
</h2>
<p>Delete Meshery containers</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system delete

</div>
</pre> 
<p>Delete Meshery containers without confirmation</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system delete -y

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -h, --help   help for delete

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string    path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -v, --verbose          verbose output
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1 id="mesheryctl-system">
	mesheryctl system
</h1>
<p>Configure, deploy, and operate Meshery deployments</p>
<h2 id="synopsis">
	Synopsis
</h2>
<p>Manage the state and configuration of Meshery server, components, and client.</p>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
mesheryctl system [flags]

</div>
</pre> 
<h2 id="options">
	Options
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.
  -h, --help             help for system
  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="options-inherited-from-parent-commands">
	Options inherited from parent commands
</h2>
<pre class='codeblock-pre'>
<div class='codeblock'>
      --config string   path to config file (default "/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml")
  -v, --verbose         verbose output

</div>
</pre>
<h2 id="see-also">
	See Also
</h2>
<p>Go back to <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/">command reference index</a>, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation">instruction</a> for guidance.</p>



<ul class="section-title">

  
    
      <li style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 2px 0;">
        <a href="/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/channel/">mesheryctl-system-channel</a>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-check&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system check&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Pre-deployment and post-deployment healthchecks for Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Verify environment pre/post-deployment of Meshery.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system check [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run all system checks for both pre and post-deployment scenarios&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system check&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run pre-deployment checks (Docker and Kubernetes)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system check --preflight&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run pre-deployment checks (Docker and Kubernetes)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system check --pre&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run checks for all Meshery adapters&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system check --adapters&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Run checks on a specific Meshery adapter&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-dashboard</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/dashboard/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/dashboard/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-dashboard&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system dashboard&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Open Meshery UI in browser.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system dashboard [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Open Meshery UI in browser&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system dashboard&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Open Meshery UI in browser and use port-forwarding (if default port is taken already)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Open Meshery UI in browser and use port-forwarding, listen on port 9081 locally, forwarding traffic to meshery server in the pod&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward -p 9081&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;(optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-delete</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/delete/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/delete/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-delete&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system delete&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete Meshery containers&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete Meshery containers. This command removes all Meshery containers created by docker-compose.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system delete [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete Meshery containers&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system delete&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Delete Meshery containers without confirmation&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system delete -y&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for delete&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-login</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/login/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/login/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-login&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system login&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Authenticate to a Meshery Server&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Authenticate to the Local or a Remote Provider of a Meshery Server&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;The authentication mode is web-based browser flow&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system login [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Login with the Meshery Provider of your choice: the Local Provider or a Remote Provider.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system login&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Login with the Meshery Provider by specifying it via -p or &amp;ndash;provider flag.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-logout</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/logout/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/logout/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-logout&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system logout&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Remove authentication for Meshery Server&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Remove authentication for Meshery Server&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;This command removes the authentication token from the user&amp;rsquo;s filesystem&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system logout [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Logout current session with your Meshery Provider.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system logout&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for logout&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-logs</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/logs/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/logs/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-logs&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system logs&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Print logs&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Print history of Meshery&amp;rsquo;s logs and begin tailing them.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;It also shows the logs of a specific component.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system logs [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Show logs (without tailing)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system logs&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Starts tailing Meshery server debug logs (works with components also)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system logs --follow&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system logs meshery-istio&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -f, --follow   (Optional) Follow the stream of the Meshery&#39;s logs. Defaults to false.&#xA;  -h, --help     help for logs&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-reset</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/reset/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/reset/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-reset&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system reset&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Reset Meshery&amp;rsquo;s configuration&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Reset Meshery to it&amp;rsquo;s default configuration.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system reset [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Resets meshery.yaml file with a copy from Meshery repo&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system reset&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help   help for reset&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl system reset&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/reset.png&#34; alt=&#34;reset-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-restart</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/restart/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/restart/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-restart&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system restart&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Stop, then start Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Restart all Meshery containers / pods.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system restart [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Restart all Meshery containers, their instances and their connected volumes&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system restart&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;(optional) skip checking for new updates available in Meshery.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system restart --skip-update&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help              help for restart&#xA;      --provider string   Provider to use with the Meshery server&#xA;      --skip-update       (optional) skip checking for new Meshery&#39;s container images.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-start</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/start/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/start/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-start&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system start&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Start Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Start Meshery and each of its cloud native components.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system start [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Start meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system start&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;(optional) skip opening of MesheryUI in browser.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system start --skip-browser&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;(optional) skip checking for new updates available in Meshery.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system start --skip-update&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Reset Meshery&amp;rsquo;s configuration file to default settings.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system start --reset&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Specify Platform to deploy Meshery to.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-status</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/status/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/status/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-status&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system status&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Check Meshery status&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Check status of Meshery and Meshery components.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system status [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Check status of Meshery, Meshery adapters, Meshery Operator and its controllers.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system status&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;(optional) Extra data in status table&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system status --verbose&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help      help for status&#xA;  -v, --verbose   (optional) Extra data in status table&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl system status&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/status.png&#34; alt=&#34;status-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-stop</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/stop/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/stop/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-stop&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system stop&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Stop Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Stop all Meshery containers / remove all Meshery resources.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system stop [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Stop Meshery&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system stop&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Reset Meshery&amp;rsquo;s configuration file to default settings.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system stop --reset&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;(optional) keep the Meshery namespace during uninstallation&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system stop --keep-namespace&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Stop Meshery forcefully (use it when system stop doesn&amp;rsquo;t work)&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system stop --force&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --force            (optional) uninstall Meshery resources forcefully&#xA;  -h, --help             help for stop&#xA;      --keep-namespace   (optional) keep the Meshery namespace during uninstallation&#xA;      --reset            (optional) reset Meshery&#39;s configuration file to default settings.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;see-also&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;See Also&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Go back to &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/&#34;&gt;command reference index&lt;/a&gt;, if you want to add content manually to the CLI documentation, please refer to the &lt;a href=&#34;/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-cli/#preserving-manually-added-documentation&#34;&gt;instruction&lt;/a&gt; for guidance.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>mesheryctl-system-update</title>
      <link>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/update/</link>
      <pubDate>Mon, 01 Jan 0001 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
      <guid>/v0.9/reference/mesheryctl/system/update/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;mesheryctl-system-update&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;mesheryctl system update&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Pull new Meshery images/manifest files.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;synopsis&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Synopsis&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Pull new Meshery container images and manifests from artifact repository.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system update [flags]&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;examples&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Examples&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Pull new Meshery images from Docker Hub. This does not update mesheryctl. This command may be executed while Meshery is running.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system update&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;p&gt;Pull the latest manifest files alone&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;mesheryctl system update --skip-reset&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt; &#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;  -h, --help         help for update&#xA;      --skip-reset   (optional) skip checking for new Meshery manifest files.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;options-inherited-from-parent-commands&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Options inherited from parent commands&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#39;codeblock-pre&#39;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#39;codeblock&#39;&gt;&#xA;      --config string    path to config file (default &#34;/home/runner/.meshery/config.yaml&#34;)&#xA;  -c, --context string   (optional) temporarily change the current context.&#xA;  -v, --verbose          verbose output&#xA;  -y, --yes              (optional) assume yes for user interactive prompts.&#xA;&#xA;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;screenshots&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Screenshots&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;Usage of mesheryctl system update&#xA;&lt;img class=&#34;content-image&#34; src=&#34;/v0.9/reference/images/update.png&#34; alt=&#34;update-usage&#34;  /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>
